input.quote: 15. ASSIGNMENT OR TRANSFER. Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
input.rationale: Section 15 is the only assignment provision (no change-of-control language appears anywhere). It fails the fallback on material terms: there is no successor/M&A carve-out for either party (a merger or sale of substantially all assets would need TrueLink's approval), no written-notice mechanic, and the approval standard is unqualified rather than "not unreasonably withheld". Rather than delete the existing no-consent affiliate right (which benefits us), we target the preferred position: Client may assign to an affiliate or transaction successor without approval, TrueLink may assign only with our consent, not unreasonably withheld, and never to a Client competitor, and a Client change of control gives TrueLink no termination right.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: TrueLink shall not assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of Client, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, and shall never assign to a competitor of Client.

ops.text: Client may assign or transfer its rights under this Agreement without approval to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, and a change of control of Client shall give TrueLink no right to terminate this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made Section 15 asymmetric as our playbook requires: TrueLink may assign only with our approval, not unreasonably withheld, and never to a competitor of Client, while Client may assign to an affiliate or transaction successor without approval and a change of control of Client gives TrueLink no termination right.
proposal.summary: Make Section 15 asymmetric: Client free to assign to affiliates/successors with no change-of-control termination right; TrueLink assignment needs Client consent and never to a competitor.

mappings.element: Customer may assign to an affiliate without consent.
Customer may assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets without consent.
Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent.
Customer's consent to Vendor assignment is not to be unreasonably withheld.
Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor.
Customer's change of control gives Vendor no termination right.
